$comment: Generated by tools/build_plugin.py in davendra/fundadmin-ai. Machine-readable index of every skill and agent in the fundadmin plugin.
name: fundadmin

install.cowork: Customize > Plugins > Add marketplace > davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills > install FundAdmin AI

invocation.auto: Hosts also pick a skill from its description when a user shares a fund document and describes the task.

outputs: Markdown files, mostly under reviews/<fund-slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<subfolder>/ in the working directory; each skill's description names its file.
disclaimer: Document analysis and drafting support only; not financial, legal or tax advice.

skills.name: fund
skills.description: Menu and router for the 62 FundAdmin AI skills. Use when the user runs `/fund` or `/fundadmin:fund`, asks what the fund admin assistant can do, or wants a fund task without naming a skill.

skills.name: fund-review-lpa
skills.description: Flagship LPA review: five agents (terms, risks, compliance, obligations, recommendations) scored into an LPA Safety Score. Use for `/fund review-lpa` or an LPA. Writes `LPA-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-review-ppm
skills.description: Scores a PPM or offering memo on risk factors, fee disclosure, regulatory status (Reg D, 3(c)(1)/(7), ERISA) and LPA fit. Use for `/fund review-ppm` or a PPM. Writes `PPM-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-review-subscription
skills.description: Checks a subscription agreement: qualification, FATCA/CRS forms, AML and ERISA reps, signatures; scores it. Use for `/fund review-subscription`. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-review-side-letter
skills.description: Inventories a side letter's rights and obligations, rates MFN cascade risk, flags LPA and side-letter conflicts. Use for `/fund review-side-letter`. Writes `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-review-capital-call
skills.description: Validates a capital call notice: pro-rata math, fees, wire instructions, due dates, LPA fit; scores 1-10. Use for `/fund review-capital-call`. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-review-distribution-notice
skills.description: Validates a distribution notice: tax credits, RWT, return of capital vs income. Use for `/fund review-distribution-notice` or a distribution notice. Writes DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-review-capital-account
skills.summary: Capital account statement review & math check
skills.description: Validates a capital account statement to the dollar: every field, ending capital math, tranches. Use for `/fund review-capital-account` or a statement. Writes CAPITAL-ACCOUNT-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-review-k1
skills.description: Reviews a Schedule K-1 (Form 1065): every box and Section L, capital account math, UBTI/ECI flags, completeness. Use for `/fund review-k1` or a K-1. Writes `K1-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-review-poa
skills.summary: Power of attorney review & risk assessment
skills.description: Reviews a power of attorney: grantor, attorneys, authority clauses, breadth of discretion, cross-border gaps. Use for `/fund review-poa` or a POA or mandate. Writes `POA-REVIEW-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-review-gp-update
skills.description: Analyzes a GP update: FPAUM bridge, deployment, realisations, fundraising, MOIC vs plan; scores 1-10. Use for `/fund review-gp-update` or a GP letter. Writes GP-UPDATE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-compare
skills.description: Compares two fund documents, rating each difference material to cosmetic and who it favors. Use for `/fund compare` or what changed between versions. Writes FUND-COMPARISON-[name]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-extract-terms
skills.description: Extracts defined terms, fees, key dates, governance and reporting duties with plain-English notes and section refs. Use for `/fund extract-terms`. Writes TERMS-EXTRACT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-draft-capital-call
skills.description: Drafts an ILPA capital call notice: purpose, per-LP pro-rata table, default terms, wire instructions. Use for `/fund draft-capital-call`. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-draft-distribution
skills.description: Drafts a distribution notice: waterfall tier math, per-LP split, withholding, clawback reserve. Use for `/fund draft-distribution`. Writes DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-draft-investor-letter
skills.description: Drafts LP letters: quarterly update, meeting notice, welcome, closing, extension, wind-down. Use for `/fund draft-investor-letter <type>`. Writes INVESTOR-LETTER-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-draft-side-letter
skills.description: Drafts an LP side letter from requested terms (fee discount, MFN, co-invest, ERISA) with LPA references. Use for `/fund draft-side-letter`. Writes SIDE-LETTER-[investor]-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-check-compliance
skills.description: Scores a fund document against FATCA, CRS, AML/KYC, ERISA, Form PF/D/ADV, AIFMD, SFDR and the Marketing Rule. Use for `/fund check-compliance`. Writes COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-kyc-review
skills.description: Scores one investor's KYC/AML package out of 100 (identity, UBOs, sanctions, PEP, source of funds) and rates risk. Use for `/fund kyc-review` or a KYC package. Writes KYC-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-regulatory-filing
skills.description: Preps a Form PF, D, ADV, 13F, FATCA/CRS or FBAR package: data points, completeness score, gaps. Use for `/fund regulatory-filing` or filing prep. Writes FILING-PREP-[type]-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-audit-support
skills.description: Audit package from capital account data: auditor confirmation letter, partner capital and fee schedules. Use for `/fund audit-support` or annual audit prep. Writes AUDIT-SUPPORT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-waterfall-review
skills.description: Extracts waterfall tiers, pref, catch-up, carry, clawback and fees, checks consistency, scores vs market. Use for `/fund waterfall-review`. Writes `WATERFALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-report-pdf
skills.summary: Professional PDF report with score gauge and risk dashboard
skills.description: Renders the latest fund review as a branded PDF with score gauge, risk dashboard and priorities; needs Python and ReportLab. Use for `/fund report-pdf`. Writes FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf.

skills.name: fund-lpa-negotiate
skills.description: Turns LP-unfavorable LPA terms into counter-language ranked P0-P4, with a negotiation roadmap and concessions. Use for `/fund lpa-negotiate`. Writes NEGOTIATION-STRATEGY-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-benchmark
skills.description: Scores economic and governance terms against reference ranges, LP-Friendly to GP-Favorable, 0-100. Use for `/fund benchmark` or market checks. Writes BENCHMARK-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-plain-english
skills.summary: Plain English translation of fund documents
skills.description: Translates a fund document clause by clause into plain English: impact, risk flags, glossary, worked examples. Use for `/fund plain-english`. Writes PLAIN-ENGLISH-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-playbook
skills.summary: Terms playbook from multiple fund documents
skills.description: Tracks how a GP's LPA terms drift across vintages and builds a playbook of positions and red lines. Use for `/fund playbook` or LPAs from several vintages. Writes TERMS-PLAYBOOK-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-search-precedent
skills.summary: Search prior reviews for similar provisions & negotiation precedent
skills.description: Searches prior reviews for matching provisions, ranked by fund, vintage and section, flagging outliers. Use for `/fund search-precedent`. Writes PRECEDENT-SEARCH-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-counsel-handoff
skills.summary: Package review analysis for external legal counsel
skills.description: Packages an LPA, PPM or side letter review into a counsel brief: P0-P3 triage, redlines, open questions. Use for `/fund counsel-handoff`. Writes COUNSEL-HANDOFF-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-mfn-tracker
skills.summary: MFN election tracking across side letters
skills.description: Tracks MFN rights across a fund's side letters: per-LP eligibility, cascade risk, election forms, disclosures. Use for `/fund mfn-tracker`. Writes MFN-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-obligation-tracker
skills.description: Inventories side letter obligations by type, frequency, due date and status, with an exam-ready log. Use for `/fund obligation-tracker`. Writes OBLIGATION-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-covenant-monitor
skills.description: Extracts financial, reporting and negative covenants from a credit facility; reports compliance and headroom. Use for `/fund covenant-monitor`. Writes COVENANT-MONITOR-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-regulatory-calendar
skills.description: 12-month filing calendar (Form ADV, PF, D, FATCA/CRS, AIFMD Annex IV) with 90/60/30-day alerts. Use for `/fund regulatory-calendar` or upcoming filings. Writes REGULATORY-CALENDAR-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-performance-calc
skills.description: Computes IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, MOIC and PME from cash flows or statements, with workpapers and J-curve. Use for `/fund performance-calc` or fund returns. Writes PERFORMANCE-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-cashflow-forecast
skills.description: Projects quarterly calls, distributions and NAV (Takahashi-Alexander) with J-curve and sensitivities. Use for `/fund cashflow-forecast` or LP liquidity. Writes CASHFLOW-FORECAST-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-scenario-model
skills.description: Models downside, base and upside cases: IRR, TVPI, DPI, carry, LP net returns, waterfall tier, breakeven. Use for `/fund scenario-model` or stress tests. Writes `SCENARIO-MODEL-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-fee-audit
skills.description: Audits management fees, offsets, expense caps, pref, catch-up, carry and clawback against the LPA and ILPA template. Use for `/fund fee-audit` or checking fees. Writes FEE-AUDIT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-investor-onboard
skills.description: Onboarding checklist by investor type: documents, accreditation and QP tests, AML/KYC, timeline. Use for `/fund investor-onboard` or a new investor. Writes ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST-[type]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-ddq-respond
skills.description: Drafts DDQ or RFP answers mapped to ILPA sections, citing sources, grading A-F, flagging items needing a human. Use for `/fund ddq-respond` or a DDQ. Writes DDQ-RESPONSE-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-entity-map
skills.description: Maps a fund structure: Mermaid diagram, entity registry, ownership and fee flows, blocker and ERISA gaps. Use for `/fund entity-map` or formation documents. Writes ENTITY-MAP-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-data-room
skills.description: ILPA-aligned data room index: eight categories, Required/Recommended/Optional status, gaps, access tiers. Use for `/fund data-room <type>` or fundraising. Writes DATA-ROOM-[type]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-portfolio-dashboard
skills.description: Rolls several funds into one LP view: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, strategy and GP mix, J-curve stage, unfunded. Use for `/fund portfolio-dashboard` or book-level status. Writes PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-reconcile
skills.description: Reconciles two fund documents line by line: call vs statement, distribution vs K-1, or two statements. Use for `/fund reconcile` or balances that don't tie. Writes RECONCILIATION-[type]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-review-deed
skills.summary: Deed of adherence / equity wrapper review
skills.description: Reviews a deed of adherence, equity wrapper or MIP agreement: obligations, vesting, leaver terms, access limits. Use for `/fund review-deed` or leaver terms. Writes DEED-REVIEW-[type]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-investor-classify
skills.summary: Auto-classify investor type & determine document requirements
skills.description: Classifies an investor's regulatory category, builds its document checklist, maps FATCA, CRS, ERISA, UBTI, ECI. Use for `/fund investor-classify`. Writes INVESTOR-CLASSIFICATION-[investor]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-fatca-crs-classify
skills.summary: FATCA/CRS tax classification & required forms determination
skills.description: Determines an investor's FATCA ch. 3/4 status, FFI/NFFE type, CRS class, forms, controlling persons. Use for `/fund fatca-crs-classify`. Writes FATCA-CRS-CLASSIFICATION-[investor]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-suitability-check
skills.summary: Qualified Purchaser / Accredited Investor / Qualified Client check
skills.description: Verifies Accredited Investor, Qualified Purchaser and Qualified Client status, flagging borderline cases. Use for `/fund suitability-check`. Writes `SUITABILITY-CHECK-[investor]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-aml-screen
skills.summary: AML screening — PEP, sanctions, source of funds, risk rating
skills.description: AML/CFT screen of an investor: ID, 25% UBOs, PEP, OFAC/UN sanctions, source of funds, adverse media, risk. Use for `/fund aml-screen`. Writes AML-SCREENING-[investor]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-kyc-tracker
skills.summary: Multi-investor KYC document collection tracker & refresh alerts
skills.description: Tracks KYC across a fund's investors: completeness, missing documents, expiry alerts, refresh cycles. Use for `/fund kyc-tracker` or fund-wide KYC status. Writes KYC-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-subscription-process
skills.summary: End-to-end subscription pipeline — classify to acceptance
skills.description: End-to-end investor onboarding: classify, documents, suitability, FATCA/CRS, AML, subscription, verdict. Use for `/fund subscription-process`. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-PROCESS-[investor]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-ingest
skills.summary: Auto-classify & batch process folder of mixed fund documents
skills.description: Classifies a folder of fund PDFs, routes each to its review skill, reconciles pairs, adds a dashboard at 3+ funds. Use for `/fund ingest`. Writes INGEST-REPORT-[date].md and INGEST-MANIFEST.md.

skills.name: fund-ingest-email
skills.summary: Parse email + attachments, cross-validate, extract action items
skills.description: Parses a GP email and attachments, checking stated amounts, dates and funds against the documents for mismatches and wire fraud. Use for `/fund ingest-email`. Writes EMAIL-INGEST-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-vault-init
skills.summary: Create Obsidian vault with dashboards, templates & Dataview queries
skills.description: Creates an Obsidian vault for fund administration: review folders, Dataview dashboards, Fund and Investor templates and an Inbox. Use for `/fund vault-init` or setting up a fund knowledge base.

skills.name: fund-vault-sync
skills.summary: Sync reviews into vault with frontmatter, tags & backlinks
skills.description: Syncs review outputs into the Obsidian vault with frontmatter, tags and Fund/Investor backlinks. Use for `/fund vault-sync` or filing reviews in the vault. Writes `VAULT-SYNC-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-monitor-email
skills.summary: Monitor Gmail for GP emails with PDF attachments, download to vault Inbox
skills.description: Scans Gmail for GP and administrator emails with PDF attachments and saves them to the vault Inbox; needs a Gmail connector. Use for `/fund monitor-email`. Writes EMAIL-MONITOR-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-multi-doc-analyze
skills.description: Cross-references related fund documents for provision conflicts, amendment lineage and MFN cascades. Use for `/fund multi-doc-analyze` or an LPA plus side letters. Writes MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-smart-contract-sim
skills.description: Simulates a distribution waterfall as code: tier-by-tier traces, edge cases, clawback checks, pseudocode. Use for `/fund smart-contract-sim`. Writes `WATERFALL-SIM-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-chat
skills.description: Answers ad hoc questions over fund documents and prior `/fund` outputs with section and quote citations, naming the command that fills a gap. Use for `/fund chat`. Answers inline.

skills.name: fund-amendment-draft
skills.description: Drafts an LPA amendment: recitals, clauses, ratification, signatures, old-vs-new redline. Use for `/fund amendment-draft` or amending an LPA. Writes AMENDMENT-DRAFT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-esg-report
skills.description: ESG report across SFDR (Art. 6/8/9, PAI), TCFD, EDCI, UN PRI and EU Taxonomy, scoring data gaps. Use for `/fund esg-report` or an SFDR/PAI disclosure. Writes ESG-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-tax-review
skills.description: Analyzes a K-1 or tax package for UBTI, ECI, 199A, 163(j), state apportionment, PFIC and capital account ties. Use for `/fund tax-review` or K-1 tax effects. Writes `TAX-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.

skills.name: fund-board-memo
skills.description: Board, LPAC or annual meeting memo: agenda, performance, conflicts, resolutions, Q&A prep. Use for `/fund board-memo <type>` or LPAC meeting materials. Writes BOARD-MEMO-[type]-[date].md.

skills.name: fund-wire-verify
skills.description: Checks new wire instructions against history for bank or beneficiary changes, FATF risk and timing anomalies, with a verification checklist. Use for `/fund wire-verify` or new bank details.

agents.name: fund-terms
agents.description: Terms analyst in the /fund review-lpa pipeline (20% of the LPA Safety Score). Use to extract and categorize every LPA provision; its output feeds the other four agents.

agents.name: fund-risks
agents.description: Risk analyst in the /fund review-lpa pipeline (25% of the LPA Safety Score). Use to score each provision 1-10 for GP-favorability, LP exposure and deviation from market.

agents.name: fund-compliance
agents.description: Compliance analyst in the /fund review-lpa pipeline (20% of the LPA Safety Score). Use to check an LPA against SEC, ERISA, FATCA/CRS, AML/KYC, AIFMD and SFDR rules.

agents.name: fund-obligations
agents.description: Obligations analyst in the /fund review-lpa pipeline (15% of the LPA Safety Score). Use to map every obligation, deadline, notice and cure period into a timeline.

agents.name: fund-recommendations
agents.description: Recommendations analyst in the /fund review-lpa pipeline (20% of the LPA Safety Score). Use last: it turns the other four outputs into ranked negotiation points and language.
